title: Stipple-ray bloom

reference.grammar: dotted-ray flower heads seen as tilted bowls, dot-screen leaves, dry-pen vines, cream paper; no fills, no outlines, no shading

ground.mottle: hash noise 3.4 u cells ±0.8 %, plus bilinear value noise 28 u and 87 u cells ±0.6 % each

units: design units, 1000 = plate width (ref 1152 px ⇒ 1 u = 1.152 ref px; measured on the 506 px copy, 1 u = 0.506 px)

techniques.name: Outer ray (burr)

params.length_u: (R − Rr)·(1 − 0.42·sinθ·sinφ); far side 1.4×, near side 0.6× on the edge-on head
params.length_mod: 0.16·(sin2φ + 0.6 sin3φ + 0.4 sin5φ)/2 ± 9 % per ray, 8 % of rays 1.12–1.24× (the burr silhouette)

techniques.implementation: Each ray starts on the rim ellipse, heads along the ellipse normal with a 0.09 rad twist and a near-side droop, and is walked at 1 u steps; every 6.0 u of arc one solid disc is placed whose Ø and color are read from the ramp at the ray parameter.

techniques.name: Tilted bowl

params.bowl_depth: corolla center displaced 0.35·Rr·sinθ toward the near side
params.order: far outer rays → calyx → inner rays (far half + sides) → rim → corolla → near rim over the corolla edge → near outer rays

techniques.implementation: The head is one bowl in local coordinates with y scaled by cosθ: a rim ellipse, a corolla sunk toward the near side, inner rays converging from rim to corolla, and outer rays leaving the rim along its normal, so a flat rim sends a crown up and a fringe down while a top-down head reads as a full disc.

techniques.name: Rim ellipse

params.rows: 1 on the ellipse (±2 u jitter) + 1 outside it (1.5–5 u), second row kept 20–100 % toward the near side
params.keep: strength·(0.35 + 0.55·near) + (1 − strength)·0.08, strength = smoothstep(9° … 40°) of tilt
params.colour: #4A5BDC (→ #95A3E8 on flat heads) mixed with #3343D6 by 0.55·near·strength
params.over_corolla: near half restroked after the corolla

techniques.implementation: Beads are placed around the projected rim at 2.4 u pitch, thinned on the far side and doubled and darkened on the near side; on top-down heads 92 % of the rim beads are dropped so the rays read as one continuous fan.

techniques.name: Bowl interior rays

params.to: corolla edge at 0.98·Rc, sunk by the bowl depth
params.bow: 0.06·L sine bow in the twist direction
params.visible: far half and sides (sinφ < 0.35), all around on top-down heads

techniques.implementation: Straight beaded runs from each rim point inward to the corolla edge, slightly bowed, pale blue and converging; the near wall is seen from outside so its inner rays are skipped.

techniques.name: Corolla dot cloud

params.fringe: white dots Ø 1.8–2.8 u, pitch 3.6 u, 2–8 u outside the lobe

techniques.implementation: Concentric jittered rings of cream dots at 4.2 u pitch fill the lobed outline (foreshortened by cosθ and sunk to the bowl bottom); a sparse white ring sits outside it and 1100 gaussian gold dots, densest at the middle, are rejected outside the lobe.

techniques.name: Calyx funnel

params.width: 2.0·Rc at the rim → 6 % at the tip

techniques.implementation: A downward triangle under tilted heads, in the head’s roll frame, filled only with cream and white dots whose density fades toward the tip; drawn after the far rays and before the near fringe.

techniques.name: Coarse dot screen

params.margin_falloff: Ø · smoothstep(−2 … +10 u inside the edge) → nothing outside
params.silhouette: cordate outline from 24 hand-set vertices (width 1.31 × height 1.76, sinus 0.34 deep, drawn-out apex), Catmull-Rom smoothed, left/right widths ×0.86–1.06 (asymmetry), midrib bent by curl·(y+0.76)²·0.32, ±2 % edge noise; heights 350+200 (overlapping pair) / 300 / 260 u

techniques.implementation: An asymmetric cordate polygon per leaf is sampled on a rotated square grid; each dot’s Ø is full in the margin band, shrinks toward the middle, and smoothsteps to zero across the last 10 u inside the edge so no outline forms; a paler half-cell-offset screen is added.

techniques.name: Interior stipple
techniques.implementation: Random fine dots whose keep-probability grows with depth inside the leaf and is modulated by two value-noise scales, giving the blotchy dark middle.

techniques.name: Dry-pen vine

params.flecks: 2 tries per 4 u step at 70 %, Ø 0.9–1.8 u, 0.5–2.2 u outside the edge, α 0.3–0.8
params.order: stroked behind all heads, then t 0.44–1.0 re-stroked in front (thin vine from t 0.42)

techniques.implementation: One cubic centerline is stroked in 4 u segments whose width is a tapered base times 1-D noise; small flecks are scattered along both edges to dry the line, and the lower run is re-stroked over the heads so the same vine passes both behind and in front.

techniques.name: Paper mottle

params.lf: bilinear value noise on an 8 px lattice, 28 u and 87 u cells, ±0.6 % each
params.vignette: −8.5 % gaussian toward the top-right corner (σ² 0.30 frame widths), −3 % toward the bottom-right (σ² 0.25)

techniques.implementation: One ImageData pass: ground color × vignette × (1 + hf + lf) per pixel.

pass_order: leaves (coarse screen, pale screen, interior stipple)
heads top to bottom: far outer rays, calyx, inner rays, rim, corolla rings, white fringe, gold speckle, near rim, near outer rays
main vine re-stroked in front from t 0.44
thin vine re-stroked in front from t 0.42
notes: All numbers measured on ref-02.png at 506 px and scaled ×1.976 to design units (1000 = 1152 ref px).

Reference: ground (236,228,211) center, (225,213,189) top-right corner, block std 1.2–3.8; ray-dot NN pitch 3.0 px (5.9 u), dot eq. Ø 2.2 px (4.3 u); ≈90 rays crossing r = 100 px; leaf grid NN 3.9–4.5 px (7.7–8.9 u), dot eq. Ø 2.5 px (4.9 u); vine 3 px (5.9 u).
Reference area shares: ground 0.75, blue 0.09, dark green 0.03; reference ray tips measured (20,36,202) in the top decile, deeper than the #2B3AD1 spot, so the tip is #1622C8.
